source_summary: Horizontal Chinese landscape with ink-and-color hills, waterside architecture, lotus pond, wooded shores, willows, and layered distant mountains. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded from all motifs.

motifs.name: misty_layered_mountain_ridge
motifs.description: Isolate the continuous pale green and blue-gray background mountain range across the middle distance, including the rounded central hill, soft distant peaks, low ridgelines, and white mist gaps between slopes.
must_preserve: rounded green central hill contour lines
broken mist edges separating hill layers
small dark shrub dots along ridge crests

motifs.name: central_tree_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the tall central grove rising behind the buildings: the large dark leafy tree, adjacent slimmer trunks, conifer-like verticals, and clustered shrubs at their base.
must_preserve: vertical ink strokes of thin trees
dense shrub dots at the base
contrast between heavy foliage and light wash background

motifs.name: waterside_pavilion_group
motifs.description: Isolate the group of thatched waterside buildings on stilts, including the long rectangular pavilion, attached lower pavilion, railings, posts, roof eaves, and reflections/posts descending into the water.
must_preserve: brown thatch strokes along roof ridges
dark reflected post marks in the water
small red and green accents near the water edge

motifs.name: lotus_pond_surface
motifs.description: Isolate the broad lotus-covered water surface in the lower center, selecting the scattered lily pads, pink blossoms, and pale water washes while excluding pavilions, banks, and willows.
must_preserve: many separate oval lotus-pad ink shapes
irregular spacing of pads across open water
subtle pale wash of the pond
tiny stems and dark pad outlines

motifs.name: right_willow_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the right foreground willow bank with two arcing willow trees, drooping leaf strands, dark trunks, low grassy mound, and the small waterfowl visible near the lotus edge.
must_preserve: split dark trunks and branch structure
dense low shrub texture at the base
nearby lotus accents that touch the bank

motifs.name: distant_wooded_peninsula
motifs.description: Isolate the middle-distance wooded peninsula and shoreline running from the center toward the right, with rows of thin trunks, dark tree crowns, low sandbars, and pale water/mist behind it.

motifs.name: right_wooded_cliff
motifs.description: Isolate the steep wooded cliff at the right edge below the inscriptions, including the sloped rock face, clustered trees, dark rocky outcrops, and small stones at the waterline.
must_preserve: dark contour strokes on the cliff edge
black rocks and pebbles at the shore
clear separation from nearby calligraphy and seal

motifs.name: left_foreground_rocky_trees
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-left foreground bank to the right of the red seal area: leaning broadleaf tree, layered shrubs, dark rocks, and grassy mound adjoining the pavilion approach.
must_preserve: dense brush texture without any seal marks

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
